svg.title: Well mode: what happens when an answer resolves
svg.desc: Four panels. 1: 7 x 8 = 56 is answered with a touching 5 and 6, outlined in jade. 2: both leave; the 3 above the 5 falls one row. 3: three new tiles, outlined in gold, drop into the lowest stacks in order, leftmost on a tie. 4: later, with all 15 cells full, the extra new tile 7 waits on the rail; the player marks an 8 for discard, its stack falls, and the 7 lands on top of that stack.
